newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sandoz says pharma margins improved in H1.
newsitem.headline: Sandoz says pharma margins improved in H1.

text.p: Sandoz AG said its phramaceuticals business saw margins improve considerably in first half 1996 thanks to strong growth in key products and continued cost control programmes.
The group reported first half operating income, excluding divestitures, or 1,632 million Swiss francs ($1.4 billion), compared with 1,497 million in the 1995 first half.
Operating income from pharmaceuticals rise to 986 million francs from 858 million.
Sandoz chief financial officer Raymund Breu said the profit margin in the pharma sector rose to 25.6 percent from 24.5 percent in the 1995 period.
Operating profit in the group's Nutrition sector was down to 182 million francs from 212 million and Agribusiness/MBT profits increased to 464 million from 427 million.

Sandoz said its Nutrition sector's profit decline was due to the cost of launching the product ReSource in the U.S. retail sector and the measures taken by its Gerber unit to strengthen its share of the U.S. baby and infant nutrition market.
